text:
Sam (product): Heads-up — I'm drafting a short decision doc for acceptance gates on new catalog entries. Need alignment on cost/SLA clauses, pinning grace windows, and migration support. Quick proposal: require benchmark pass (latency/QPS), quality delta limit, quantization compatibility, and an ops-fee rule for high-cost models. Thoughts?

Anya (eng-ml): sg. we should be explicit about which eval datasets/metrics + fixed seeds. also separate chat vs embedding quality metrics.

Kevin (platform): From infra perspective: hosted L0 should have p99 <= 300ms for typical prompt shapes. Dedicated needs throughput SLO + burst rules. ops-fee makes sense, but tie it to measured token-cost per-million.

Morgan (sales): customers keep asking for version pins for 6+ months. can we offer pin + paid migration support (cutover assistance, regressions triage)? they'd pay for predictable migration windows.

Jorge (customer-success): customers want canary windows and opt-in rollback. please include per-tenant grace periods for pins so we don't break contracts.

Sam (product): Draft acceptance gating matrix (first pass):

```
acceptance_gates:
- latency_p99: "<=300ms" (hosted L0)
- throughput: "min 200 tokens/sec per GPU" (dedicated baseline)
- quality_delta: "<=2% absolute on canonical eval set (chat or embed-specific)"
- eval_runs: "zero-shot + 5-shot; fixed seeds; harness id required"
- quant_support: "int8 tested; fallback path validated"
- pin_grace: "180 days opt-in; migration_support: available as paid service"
- ops_fee_threshold: "apply ops fee if model_cost_per_million_tokens >= $300"
- rollback_ease: "estimate minutes/hours to revert per-customer"
```

Anya (eng-ml): :thumbsup: Add harness id, include seed list and RNG version. recommend running 3 replicate evals and report median.

Kevin (platform): How do we enforce the quant testing? CI perf runner + nightly smoke. @deploy-bot can you kick off perf-bench job against new model builds?

deploy-bot: perf-bench triggered -> job id: 2795-catalog-gate-check. Results will be posted to https://internal/bench/2795012345 (will include p99, throughput, mem, kv-cache behavior).

Sam (product): If perf-bench and eval pass, we'll open a PR to the catalog with pinned metadata, migration notes, and customer-impact doc. Plan: bake this gating matrix into the onboarding template and circulation doc. I'll send draft by EOD.

Morgan (sales): We'll add a standard paid migration addendum to contract templates. ping me for pricing tiers (fast migration vs self-service).

Jorge (customer-success): small ask — include a short 'rollback play' field in the metadata that says how quickly we can flip a tenant back and what data migrations are required. customers care about minutes vs hours.

Sam (product): Noted — will add rollback_ease to the metadata and a checkbox for data-migration complexity. thanks all :party-parrot:
